learning_from.description: The learner's explanation/source language. Every registered learn-from language may participate when its localized bridge copy exists.

learning_language_full.description: A currently learnable target language with researched family-member distinctions, representative terms, an English canonical explainer, cultural cautions, and practice-ready relation features.

learning_language_comparison.description: A registered language outside the full set may participate in Core Family sessions and recognition-safe Games when stage vocabulary exists, but must not receive invented cultural/usage analysis.

resolver.cultural_when: learning_from is full AND learning language is full
resolver.core_when: either active role is not full

forbidden_without_both_roles_full: rich target practice that depends on missing distinctions

3.core_104: ready_for_existing extended-family concepts in universal game vocabulary
3.other_full_language_cultural: target profiles already contain substantial kinship distinctions; stage-specific review still required

4.other_full_language_cultural: requires relationship vocabulary and usage review

runtime_model.source_first: Show a localized bridge in the learner's strongest learning-from language.
runtime_model.depth_second: Resolve session_depth from BOTH active language roles before selecting blocks. A Tier 3 source cannot unlock Cultural content merely because the target is Tier 1/2.
runtime_model.target_third: Resolve the selected target's stage-safe vocabulary/profile. If session_depth is Core, omit cultural blocks even when the target has a rich profile.
runtime_model.pair_scaling: Do not author a 104 x N matrix. Source copy, target facts, stage vocabulary, and cultural analysis are independent assets joined at runtime.
runtime_model.fallback: If required Core stage vocabulary is missing, show the localized intro and only the verified concepts available for that stage; never silently substitute English or invent translations.
runtime_model.english_spanish_reference: English to Spanish remains the worked reference pair for rich kinship comparison.
